message.content:
Implemented `payments_between` in `ledgerly/reporting.py`:

- Both `start` and `end` are passed through `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc()`, so naive datetimes raise `BillingError("naive_datetime", ...)` and aware datetimes are normalized to UTC.
- Payment `created_at` values are also normalized to UTC before comparison, so offset-aware timestamps compare correctly.
- Returns payments in the half-open window `[start, end)`, sorted oldest first; `None` timestamps are skipped.

All 10 tests pass, and edge cases (naive rejection, non-UTC offsets) were verified.
